overview_description.description:
Cortex is the Engineering Operations Platform that enables organizations to continuously improve their operational maturity and reduce developer friction. With centralized visibility, clear ownership, automated Scorecards, and golden paths, we help engineering organizations operate as one. 

Our customers – from startups to Fortune 100 enterprises  – create a culture of engineering excellence, reducing incidents by 30% and improving MTTR by 50%, all while making it easier for developers to focus on building.

about_short_description.short_description: The Engineering Operations Platform that enables teams to improve their operational maturity and reduce developer friction.

product.name: Internal Developer Portal (IDP)
product.description: A platform that centralizes engineering tools and information to support software development, deployment, and maintenance, ensuring ownership and alignment to standards.

product.name: Developer Onboarding Automation
product.description: Automates tasks like account creation and secrets allocation to accelerate new developer onboarding and improve information discovery.

product.name: Modernization and Migration Tracking
product.description: Tracks progress and enforces alignment during major software framework changes using live data feeds and targeted alerts.

product.name: Production Readiness Management
product.description: Defines and enforces production standards for services and resources, using templates and real-time scorecards to track compliance.

product.name: Incident Response Support
product.description: Centralizes ownership, context, and runbooks to improve incident response times and ensure up-to-date on-call information.

product.name: Self-Service Developer Workflows
product.description: Enables developers to perform tasks like software scaffolding and approvals with workflow automations and one-click templates, maintaining consistency and reducing manual work.
